summary: Iteration 27 — Production end-to-end validation on https://www.mwana-lingala.com (Railway deployment). Backend: 22/22 pytest PASS (test_iteration27_prod.py): /api/ 200, /api/early-bird/status returns {limit:10, claimed:0, remaining:10, active:true, trial_days:30}, /api/testimonials 200 (3 items, no _id leak), /api/words 200, /api/auth/google/start 200 with auth_url pointing to accounts.google.com and redirect_uri=https://www.mwana-lingala.com/auth/google correctly URL-encoded, invalid scheme rejected 400, /api/auth/google/exchange with fake code behaves correctly, /api/auth/request-otp with admin@mwana-lingala.com returns 200 {success:true, message:'Code envoyé', expires_in_minutes:10} → SMTP Amen.fr IS WORKING in prod, invalid email 422. All 11 public pages (/, /login, /traduction-lingala, /cgu, /rgpd, /mentions-legales, /blog, /tarifs, /contact, /widget/mot-du-jour, /app/admin) return 200. /sw.js, /manifest.webmanifest 200. GA4 script G-C6B5K4VKLB correctly injected. Frontend (Playwright, DESKTOP 1440x900 + MOBILE 375x812): Home H1 'Apprenez le Lingala à votre enfant, naturellement' displays correctly. Navbar desktop EXACTLY ['Accueil','Traduire','Pourquoi le Lingala','Assistant IA','Blog','Tarifs','Contact'] + 'Se connecter' CTA. Footer has /cgu, /rgpd, /mentions-legales + 7 other links. ShareBlock present with data-testid share-whatsapp-btn (href=wa.me/?text=...), share-copy-btn (clickable), share-email-btn — heading 'Partagez Mwana Lingala à un proche'. Section order on home: Comment ça marche → Pourquoi Mwana Lingala → Trois modes → Simple rapide guidé → Transmettre → Commencez gratuitement → Partagez → CTA final. EarlyBirdBanner (data-testid earlybird-banner) displays on both desktop + mobile; mobile width=375px, height=132.5px, NO horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=375 = viewport). earlybird-claim ('Je réserve ma place') + earlybird-dismiss (X) both visible on both viewports. /login: consent-checkbox FOUND, google-login-btn + otp-request-btn BOTH DISABLED until checkbox is checked (client-side gate works). Trust badges all present: 'Connexion chiffrée (HTTPS)', 'Aucun mot de passe stocké', 'RGPD-compliant'. 'Mollie PCI-DSS' mention IS NOT PRESENT (as required). All legal pages (/cgu, /rgpd, /mentions-legales) render proper H1/H2. /blog heading 'Le Blog Lingala', /tarifs 'Tarifs simples', /contact 'Contact', /traduction-lingala 'Traduction Français ↔ Lingala'. Console errors on prod home = 13×401 (all are /api/auth/me calls when not logged in — expected behavior for public visit) + 1 DNS error from a 3rd-party analytics collect URL (harmless). No JS pageerror. Overall production is functional and matches spec.

ui_bugs.issue: No native Web Share API button on mobile — spec asked for '4 boutons WhatsApp, Copier le lien, Email + native share sur mobile'. Only 3 buttons (share-whatsapp-btn, share-copy-btn, share-email-btn) are rendered on mobile viewport 375px. navigator.share() is not wired to any button. Low priority.

Page loads but has no visible H1/H2 heading (empty first-heading in query). This may be intentional (minimal chrome for iframe embed) but the widget card itself should still contain headings for screen readers.

issues: Most pages share the generic <title> 'Mwana Lingala — Apprenez le Lingala à votre enfant, naturellement' (home default). Only /blog and /traduction-lingala override it. /cgu, /rgpd, /mentions-legales, /tarifs, /contact, /login, /widget/mot-du-jour, /pourquoi-lingala, /assistant-ia all inherit the home title — missed SEO opportunity and duplicate-title SEO penalty. Set per-page <title> via react-helmet-async or similar.

https://mwana-lingala.com (without www) is NOT configured — DNS resolution works (no NXDOMAIN) but Railway forwards to a courtesy page. User must add the apex as a custom domain in Railway and either serve the same app OR 301-redirect to https://www.mwana-lingala.com. This is user-known per agent-to-agent note.

action_items: SEO: add unique <title> + <meta description> per route (react-helmet-async). Current duplicate titles on /cgu, /rgpd, /mentions-legales, /tarifs, /contact, /login, /pourquoi-lingala, /assistant-ia.
ShareBlock: add a 4th button wired to navigator.share() rendered only on mobile (feature-detect). Spec explicitly asked for it.

WidgetMotDuJour: add a visually hidden

Mot du jour — {lingala}

for accessibility inside the widget card.
DNS/Domain: configure apex https://mwana-lingala.com in Railway (redirect to www or serve same app).
Low priority: server.py still 2624 lines — split into routers/ modules (flagged since iter14).
Low priority: Login client-side-only consent gate — add consent_accepted persistence server-side on /auth/google/exchange + /auth/request-otp for an audit trail.
Low priority: inconsistent OAuth response key naming — /auth/google/start returns 'auth_url' but /drive/auth-url returns 'authorization_url'.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate <title> across most routes is a real SEO issue in production. Easy fix with react-helmet-async and per-route Seo component.
ShareBlock omits native share on mobile despite spec requirement — feature is 10 lines with navigator.share?.() feature-detection.
Login.jsx consent gate is client-side only (disabled attribute). Persist consent_accepted=true on user document + audit timestamp on the first auth request payload.
WidgetMotDuJour.jsx still hardcodes https://mwana-lingala.com for image base URL — fine now that prod is live, but move to REACT_APP_WIDGET_ASSET_BASE_URL for flexibility.
Prod /api/auth/request-otp returns 200 in <1s, meaning SMTP Amen.fr is functional — great. Continue to monitor bounce rate for DKIM/SPF deliverability.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (spec met except native share + SEO titles)

test_credentials: Admin OTP endpoint responded 200 for admin@mwana-lingala.com → code sent to real Outlook/Amen mailbox. Did NOT complete login (no inbox access).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Prod URL is https://www.mwana-lingala.com (WITH www). Apex https://mwana-lingala.com returns Railway/Amen courtesy page — DNS/domain config pending user action. /api/auth/request-otp IS working in prod (SMTP Amen). Google OAuth /api/auth/google/start returns proper auth_url with redirect_uri=https://www.mwana-lingala.com/auth/google — exchange will only succeed once the user registers that URI in Google Cloud Console. No session cookie reusable on prod (tests were Mongo-injected on preview only). data-testid prefixes: 'earlybird-*' and 'share-*-btn' (not 'early-bird-*' nor 'share-*').
